name: Brian Redman
features: fair hair, long thin face, quiet self-deprecating manner, slight build
bio: The Lancashire driver Porsche and Ferrari both wanted in the car for the long stints. Shared the Gulf 917K with Jo Siffert through 1970, took the Targa Florio and the Spa 1000 km with him, and always said he only did it for the money. Nobody believed him.
